expected_outcomes: Each change has a bounded, reviewable mission.
required_actions: Read before editing and keep one mission per branch.
acceptance: No unrelated cleanup or silent scope expansion is included.
verification: Inspect the branch diff and test results.
evidence: Focused branch, reviewed diff, and command results.
failure_conditions: Checks are disabled or completion is inferred without execution.
exceptions: Document any explicit compatibility break or scope exception.
